Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's economic growth could reach nearly 7%, surpassing the central bank's previous 6.7% forecast. Data & Insights.summary: Fearing that ethanol-blended E20 petrol will damage their vehicle engines and reduce mileage, consumers are increasingly purchasing premium high-octane fuel. This trend has driven premium petrol's share of total sales up from about four percent in March to between 12 and 15 percent.
